title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Briones in the Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Briones in the Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Briones tại Đô thị Kalibo, Tỉnh Aklan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Briones ในเทศบาล Kalibo จังหวัด Aklan
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Briones di Kotamadya Kalibo, Provinsi Aklan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Briones di Perbandaran Kalibo, Wilayah Aklan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2180_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Eu-ok in the barrio of Mabilo, Municipality of Kalibo, Province of Aklan, is separated from said barrio, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Briones.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 2, 1959.
